description: External dataset catalog for Personal AI eggplant eval harness (ODSC, HiddenLayer, HF WebDataset trending, text-RAG recommendations).

sources.name: arcee-ai/agent-data
sources.notes: Training corpus; tool schemas do not match builtin_tools.

sources.name: ToolBench (toolbench-v1)

sources.notes: Paper + custom runtime; not on HuggingFace as a single dataset.

sources.name: webshop_expert_trajectories

sources.name: ALFRED
sources.notes: Embodied vision + control.

sources.name: WebArena

sources.name: WebChoreArena

sources.name: MiniWoB++

sources.name: GAIA

sources.name: AgentBench
